notable_absence.finding: ANSI Merge and Lookup Merge are explicitly presented as two alternative syntaxes for the same statement (each Lookup Merge example is labelled 'Lookup merge version of Example N'), but the docs recommend ANSI Merge 'exclusively, where possible' rather than declaring them interchangeable - this is weaker than the isSynonymOf shape used for DROP INDEX/DROP VECTOR INDEX (which the docs declare 'functionally identical'), so no isSynonymOf relation was minted here despite the structural similarity.

cross_product_finding: Recurrence of the known issue docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: the Optimizer Hints subsection is headed 'Couchbase Server 8.0' and the merge-target/merge-source notes repeat 'In Couchbase Server 8.0 and later, you can also use optimizer hints...' - literal server version citations on a Capella statement page that has no discrete version numbers of its own.
